Basic Pitch
Copyright 2022 Spotify AB

This application embeds a NNEF conversion of the Basic Pitch model from Spotify.
The model and upstream inference/window constants are licensed under the
Apache License, Version 2.0; see LICENSE.

Upstream: https://github.com/spotify/basic-pitch
Commit: fa5997af0a8210982619003269994a1be25eddf3
Model: basic_pitch/saved_models/icassp_2022/nmp.onnx
Model card: https://huggingface.co/spotify/basic-pitch

The original ONNX source is retained for reproducibility. Only the NNEF file is
compiled into the application. The pinned tract 0.23.9 build-time converter fixes
the input shape and serializes a typed, decluttered graph. No training or
quantization was applied; model weights are preserved. See provenance.json and
scripts/chord-model-converter for source hashes and reproducible conversion.

The application supplies its own streaming resampler and uses absolute input
window positions for timestamps.
